# alien-syntax/alpha on 3dom-grammar/1.1.0 — NEGATIVE conformance corpus
# Every non-comment line is exactly ONE invalid program and MUST be rejected.
# GENERATED by applying phi to the Phase 1 negative corpus; each item keeps
# its VIOLATES/MUTATION annotation verbatim, because production names are
# frozen by I1 and so the annotation transfers unchanged. Generating these by
# phi is itself an isomorphism check: a 3DOM near-miss that stopped being a
# near-miss would mean phi moved something structural.
#
#
# ── iife (the mandatory wrapper) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-wrapper (bare statement, no IIFE)
$$('#wheel')#scale('#111111');
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-outer-parens
recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#spin(); }();
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-trailing-call ()
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#spin(); });
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-final-semicolon
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#spin(); })()
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-keyword-function
(){ $$('#wheel')#spin(); }();
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION misspell-function
(functon(){ $$('#wheel')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-braces
(recolor() $$('#wheel')#spin(); )();
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-open-brace
(recolor() $$('#wheel')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION delete-param-parens-of-function
(recolor{ $$('#wheel')#spin(); })();
#
# ── statement (chain ';') ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES statement | MUTATION delete-terminating-semicolon
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#spin() })();
# VIOLATES statement | MUTATION two-selcalls-without-chain-or-semicolon
(recolor(){ $$('#a') $$('#b'); })();
# VIOLATES statement | MUTATION chain-without-selector-entry
(recolor(){ #scale('#111111'); })();
#
# ── selector_call ($S '(' quoted_selector ')') ───────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES selector_call | MUTATION misspell-entry ($D)
(recolor(){ $D('#wheel')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES selector_call | MUTATION drop-parens-around-selector
(recolor(){ $$'.wheel'#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES selector_call | MUTATION unquoted-selector
(recolor(){ $$(#wheel)#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES selector_call | MUTATION number-where-selector-expected
(recolor(){ $$(5)#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES selector_call | MUTATION missing-close-paren
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel'#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES quoted_selector | MUTATION mismatched-quotes (D2: open ' close ")
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel")#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES quoted_selector | MUTATION mismatched-quotes (D2: open " close ')
(recolor(){ $$("#wheel')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES quoted_selector | MUTATION empty-selector-string
(recolor(){ $$('')#spin(); })();
#
# ── operation_call ('.' verb '(' args? ')') ──────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES verb | MUTATION unknown-verb (frobnicate not in the closed 15)
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#frobnicate(':111111'); })();
# VIOLATES verb | MUTATION verb-typo (recolour)
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#recolour(':111111'); })();
# VIOLATES verb | MUTATION capitalised-verb (Delete)
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#Delete(); })();
# VIOLATES operation_call | MUTATION missing-chain-dot
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')spin(); })();
# VIOLATES operation_call | MUTATION missing-arg-parens
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#spin; })();
# VIOLATES operation_call | MUTATION unbalanced-open-paren
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#spin(; })();
# VIOLATES operation_call | MUTATION double-dot
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')##spin(); })();

# ── argument_list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES argument_list | MUTATION trailing-comma
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#rotate(1,2,); })();
# VIOLATES argument_list | MUTATION leading-comma
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#rotate(,1,2); })();
# VIOLATES argument_list | MUTATION double-comma
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#rotate(1,,2); })();
# VIOLATES argument | MUTATION malformed-number (two dots)
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#move(1.2.3); })();
# VIOLATES argument | MUTATION lone-decimal-point
(recolor(){ $$('#wheel')#move(#); })();
# VIOLATES argument | MUTATION unquoted-string-arg (bareword)
(recolor(){ $$('#fan')#duplicate(y,1,2); })();
# VIOLATES argument | MUTATION mismatched-quote-in-arg (D2)
(recolor(){ $$('#body')#setOpacity('glass"); })();

(recolor(){ $$('#')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES id_selector | MUTATION hash-with-no-name
(recolor(){ $$(':')#spin(); })();

(recolor(){ $$('#a!b')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES id_selector | MUTATION space-in-name (splits into descendant, dangling)
(recolor(){ $$(':dump bed ')#spin(); })();

# ── selector: child_combinator ('>') ──────────────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES child_combinator | MUTATION gt-no-right-compound
(recolor(){ $$('#a*')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES child_combinator | MUTATION gt-no-left-compound
(recolor(){ $$('*#a')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES child_combinator | MUTATION double-gt
(recolor(){ $$('#a**#b')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES child_combinator | MUTATION gt-trailing-space-no-compound
(recolor(){ $$('#a * ')#spin(); })();
#
# ── selector: descendant_combinator / leading-trailing layout (L2) ────────────
# VIOLATES descendant_combinator | MUTATION dangling-descendant (trailing space)
(recolor(){ $$('#a #')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES complex_selector | MUTATION leading-space-in-selector (L2)
(recolor(){ $$(' #a')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES complex_selector | MUTATION trailing-space-in-selector (L2)
(recolor(){ $$('#a ')#spin(); })();

# ── compound_selector / wildcard ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES wildcard | MUTATION wildcard-then-matcher (star not standalone)
(recolor(){ $$('.#wheel')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES compound_selector | MUTATION empty-then-combinator
(recolor(){ $$(' * #a')#spin(); })();
#
# ── ops / chain structure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# VIOLATES operation_call | MUTATION stray-comma-between-ops
(recolor(){ $$('#a')#spin(),#move(2); })();
# VIOLATES chain | MUTATION selector-in-op-position
(recolor(){ $$('#a')#$$('#b'); })();

# VIOLATES stmts | MUTATION stray-token-in-body
(recolor(){ foo $$('#a')#spin(); })();

(recolor(){ $$('#a')#spin(); )();
# VIOLATES iife | MUTATION extra-close-brace
(recolor(){ $$('#a')#spin(); }})();

(recolor(){ $$(''#wheel'')#spin(); })();
# VIOLATES operation_call | MUTATION verb-without-selector-context
(recolor(){ scale('#111111'); })();

# VIOLATES statement | MUTATION semicolon-before-chain
